rules.pass: A role that runs here is online under its supervisor.
rules.warn: A role is starting or stopping, runs without a supervisor, or has restarted 3 or more times and has run for less than 10 minutes.
rules.fail: A role that runs here is stopped, or its supervisor gave up on it.
rules.unknown: The roles, or a role's process row, could not be read.

advice.not-running: The {role} is not running. Start it with the role command, then check the start errors. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.
advice.errored: The supervisor gave up restarting the {role}. Read its log for the cause. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.
advice.changing: The {role} is starting or stopping. Run the doctor again in a minute.
advice.unsupervised: The {role} runs without a supervisor, so nothing restarts it if it stops. Start it with the role command instead. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.
advice.restarting: The {role} restarted {restarts} times and has run for {minutes} minutes. Read its log for the cause. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.

rules.skipped: This check is not in this release.

rules.pass: The relay runs, or it stopped without a start error.
rules.fail: The relay stopped, and the last start error in its error capture or log is named.
rules.unknown: Neither the error capture nor the log could be read.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.none: The relay shows no start error.
advice.p2p-in-use: The relay could not listen on port {port}, because another program uses it. Stop that program or choose another P2P port in the relay's configuration. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.
advice.p2p-cannot-listen: The relay could not listen on its P2P address. Check the address in its configuration. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.
advice.api-in-use: The relay could not open its API on port {port}, because another program uses it. Stop that program or choose another API port in the relay's configuration. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.
advice.api-cannot-listen: The relay could not open its API on the address in its configuration. Check the address. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.
advice.version-floor: The relay refused to start because the network no longer accepts this version. Install the current release. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/updating/.
advice.api-https: The relay's API is set to HTTPS, which this release does not serve. Turn it off in the API configuration. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.
advice.config: The relay could not read its configuration. Check the file named in the log. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.
advice.other: The relay stopped with an error the doctor does not sort. Read its log. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/running/.
